## Description
Provide a concise explanation of the changes made and the motivation behind them.

## Related Issues
Closes #(issue)

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Refactoring / Architecture optimization

## Verification Checklist
- [ ] Code follows project style guidelines and naming conventions
- [ ] All unit tests pass (`python -m unittest discover tests`)
- [ ] No temporary artifacts, binary logs, or files > 50MB added
- [ ] Documentation updated in `README.md`
